thread:
Rina Shah: Heads-up — eng intends to land a breaking change in partner SDK v4 next month: drop legacy `batch` envelope and require `X-Redwood-Auth: v2`. This touches marketplace connectors, on-prem HW adapters, and SI integrations. Need partner-facing plan.
Omar Velasquez: Can we get concrete schedule? Partners expect clear dates.
Rina Shah: Proposal: spec published in 10 days, code freeze in 21 days, 60-day deprecation after freeze. Offer a short compatibility shim for Dedicated/on-prem.
Tasha Nguyen: HW partners: many maintain monthly firmware cycles; 60 days is risky for some. A shim or opt-in grace period is essential.
Gabe Kim: Engineering can ship a feature-flagged shim (`--compat=shim|warn|strict`) that translates old `batch` -> `requests` for 45 days post-freeze. We'll add opt-in telemetry so partners can consent to metrics.
Ivy Park: GTM ask: partner comms kit (email, FAQ, migration checklist, marketplace banner) and two migration webinars. I'll draft the kit once spec lands.
marketplace-bot: Draft saved to /mkplace/drafts/sdk-v4-interop.
Rina Shah: Action items: 1) Gabe -> publish header + payload spec and shim plan (ETA 7 days). 2) Ivy -> comms kit + webinar dates (ETA 9 days). 3) Omar/Tasha -> list of impacted partners and HW timing constraints (ETA 6 days).
Omar Velasquez: I'll compile the partner impact matrix and suggest a short canary roster for early validation.
Tasha Nguyen: We'll run shim tests against our gateway fleet if we get a build artifact within 7 days.
Gabe Kim: Will push a minimal detection snippet in the repo soon: responses include `X-Redwood-Deprecation: batch-v3` when legacy envelope detected.
Rina Shah: Great. Let's reconvene on this thread after specs land. Flag blockers here. :white_check_mark:
